# Project Maya — Technical Summary

**Project Maya** is a free, open-source local inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) that runs on consumer hardware by tiering model experts across VRAM, pinned RAM, and NVMe SSD.

## Core architecture
- **Expert tiering:** ~95% of parameters are routed experts; the engine fills GPU VRAM with hot experts, pins a RAM tier, and streams the rest from SSD. Sizes itself automatically per machine (layer splits across
